name: Investor
definition: Party which makes investment decisions in relation with its investment account.

NewIssuePermission.name: New Issue Permission
NewIssuePermission.definition: Indicates whether the investor permits its beneficial owners to participate in profits and losses attributed to new issue securities.

DeMinimusApplicable.name: De Minimus Applicable
DeMinimusApplicable.definition: Determine if the investor is covered by the "de minimis" exemption.

Restricted.name: Restricted
Restricted.definition: Indicates whether the investor is eligible to participate in the profits and losses from a new issue.
